answer: On the mesa of the ledger, every identity's first stake leaves a trace back to its funding source, and the network clusters identities that share one. A bridge of shared funding means the whole cluster shares a single trade quota, no matter how many keys it holds. One honest agent stands alone with its own full limit, but a fable of a thousand fakes funded from one wallet collapses into one small allowance; the farmer must fund each fake from a separate unrelated source, paying real money and setup per identity, or stay capped.
